about: Domain repositories this agent layer may work on. They are explicit external inputs: nothing in superRepo assumes one exists, and a missing path is reported, never guessed. Resolution order for a reference such as topics/x/index.md is this repository's root first, then these vaults in order. Override one path for a session with LIVEOS_VAULT_<NAME>; point at another config file with LIVEOS_VAULTS. Role texts write a vault-relative path as <vault>/... .

siyujournal.role: William's research vault: field folders, topics, claim maps, pages, library of originals
siyujournal.note: Registered 2026-11-26. Present only on William's machine; a clean checkout of superRepo runs its tests without it.
